newsitem.title: DUBAI: BA books Saudi passengers on other carriers.
newsitem.headline: BA books Saudi passengers on other carriers.

text.p: British Airways (BA) passengers from Saudi Arabia will be booked on other carriers during a three-day strike by the airline's cabin crew which started on Wednesday, al-Eqtisadiah newspaper reported.

"British Airways is negotiating to lease a Boeing 747 from Saudi Arabian Airlines and has made alternative booking arrangements for its passengers on the Saturday flight to London," the Jeddah-based daily quoted a BA official in Saudi Arabia as saying.
He said arrangements were also being made for more than 450 passengers with bookings on the airline's two flights from Jeddah to London on Thursday and Friday.

Members of the Transport and General Workers Union (T&G) began the strike at 6.00 a.m.(05.00 GMT) despite a warning from BA that strikers would lose perks and face a lockout unless they promised to work normally in the future.
The industrial action came after an impasse on Sunday in negotiations over pay and conditions between management and the T&G, the main union involved in the strike.
